_comment: OpenFrp, a way in: frpc on this box holds a connection to an OpenFrp node and forwards each connection made to the tunnel's public port to the agent port. The Access page writes this file.
_comment_is_enabled: Whether the way in is on, written by the Access page's switch.
_comment_credential: OpenFrp's Authorization from the last login, sealed under the vault's data key; empty for none. A new one OpenFrp hands back replaces it.
_comment_tunnel_id: OpenFrp's id of the picked tunnel, empty for none.
_comment_node_name: The picked tunnel's node name, as the apply read it.
_comment_local_port: The picked tunnel's local port at OpenFrp, as the apply read it; the connection port when the tunnel was picked.
_comment_public_host: The tunnel's public address: connectAddress split at its last colon. Clients are given it after SakuraFrp's.
